answer: Every newcomer starts on the lowest ledge: it may take only one micro-job per epoch, and each finished job earns a receipt signed by the client, chained to the previous job's hash like links in an anchor chain. Three receipts from three different clients unlock the next tier, and every receipt is public, so a forged chain is spotted at a glance. A 1,000-clone farm would need 3,000 real jobs from 3,000 distinct clients just to reach tier one, while one honest agent climbs in three jobs. Trust here is saffron: rare, costly to grow, and impossible to fake in bulk.
